scope: Independent Happy DOM checks with virtual JS time and mocked geometry/WAAPI. Verifies DOM/state/callback contracts, not rendered frames, actual browser events, performance or phone behavior.

checks.name: Cancel new adventure retains exact saved state and confirmation causes no record
Abandon is confirmed once, clears save and cannot double-settle
Rapid plays trigger exactly one first-break effect
Monster is removed at die completion rather than returning to idle
Nonfatal attack permits cards and survives orientation change
Rotate during loot death transition retains the choices and future progress
Rotate after loot choice does not duplicate reward or enter another battle
Rotating fatal attack and repeated pagehide preserves single settlement
Storage write failure during outcome retries after leaving result without stale Continue
Stable loot and result relayout keep one persistent banner
Pending older settlement can finish after a new adventure without deleting it
Undo during mirror transition never leaves an unresolved overlay or hidden resolved card
All 37 supplied SVGs load as art including the five new references
